reisa.title: Reisa.is – Hafnarfjörður campsite (booking page, zones & facilities)

intro.value: A small, family-friendly campsite on Víðistaðatún, a sculpture park surrounded by lava in Hafnarfjörður, about 5 minutes from the town centre. It is run by the Hraunbúar scout association, and profits go to youth scouting.

address.value: Víðistaðatún, 220 Hafnarfjörður (drive in along the path beside Lava Hostel / the scout hall)

winter.value: Closed in winter: the season is 15 May – 30 September. On 31 October 2026 the booking page showed the site as closed, reopening 15 May.

items.label: Car, motorhome or caravan, incl. 1 adult, per night
Lodging tax per tent/vehicle/caravan per night

electricity.value: Yes – Zone B has 9 bookable pitches, all with a power socket (1,300 ISK/night). Zone C's 11 pitches have no sockets; you need a long extension cable to reach the sockets in Zone B across the road.

kitchen.value: No indoor kitchen or indoor guest area. There are outdoor sinks for washing up, charcoal grills, outdoor tables and a roofed outdoor kitchen with a grill.

showers.value: Yes – showers included in the price

dump_station.value: Yes – listed as 'Losun fyrir ferðasalerna' (portable/cassette toilet disposal) on the booking page and 'Waste disposal for mobile homes' on tjalda.is. Exact location on site: Unconfirmed.

wifi.value: Free Wi-Fi, but only by the gate

laundry.value: Washing machine and dryer, included in the price

camping_card.note: Not stated in the sources checked.

practical.value: Maximum vehicle length on pitches in Zones B and C is 8 metres. Zone A is for tents only; cars with rooftop tents must book Zone B or C.
Maximum stay 7 nights. One motorhome, caravan or trailer per pitch. Dogs allowed on a lead. American Express is not accepted.
Pitches can be booked online through Reisa.is; drop-in guests are also accepted.
